thread:
Ria Chen: Quick pass on Compliance Console UI before release. Small copy + a11y nits.
Marco Valdez: Drop the notes here, I'll pick up the PR.
Ria Chen: 1) Region control label: currently just `Region`. Suggest `Data residency (region)` so it's clear logs/backups are affected.
Hannah Yi: Agree. Also prefer friendly names `US (Ashburn)`, `EU (Frankfurt)` instead of region codes.
Ria Chen: 2) Retention dropdown: show units (`7 days`, `30 days`) and add microcopy: `Retention counted from ingestion time (UTC).`
Marco Valdez: For Dedicated customers, show an inline `Estimated monthly cost` when >365 days selected. Conditional only.
Ria Chen: 3) KMS label is terse. Use `Customer encryption key (KMS)` and helper `Leave blank to use Redwood-managed keys.` Show masked key `rwd-...-2f9b` with a copy icon and aria-label `Copy key id`.
Hannah Yi: KMS input missing a label element for screen readers. Also add aria-live announcement `Key copied` on copy.
Ria Chen: 4) Audit Logs: primary action rename `Download CSV` and chevron menu for `Send to S3 / Webhook / SIEM`. Change quick presets to `Last 24 hours`, `Last 7 days`.
Marco Valdez: Accessibility: contrast on muted links fails dark theme. Use AA contrast 4.5:1. Region listbox needs role=listbox + aria-activedescendant so arrow keys work.
ops-bot: Automated note: axe snapshot uploaded to ticket PROD-4622 by Marco Valdez at 1766450200.
Ria Chen: I'll create the design PR with copy updates and small Figma annotations for a11y. Tagging eng for the KMS affordance and region keyboard behavior. Thanks.
